title: kiosk-display-auto-sleep-enabled
description: Payload for the kiosk auto-sleep-enabled topics. Published retained by the kiosk node to renewvan/kiosk/display/auto-sleep-enabled (state), publishing its default (false) on startup if no retained value exists; sent unretained by the dashboard to renewvan/kiosk/display/auto-sleep-enabled/set (command). When true, the kiosk node puts the display to sleep after renewvan/kiosk/display/auto-sleep-timeout-minutes of no touch activity, independent of the remote-sleep-allowed gate.
